segments.text: If you slept on this airdrop you missed a generational bag in the trenches.
Three liquidations cascaded in twelve minutes. The whale got wrecked on 40x leverage.
Don't fade this tape. The runner printed while funding flipped negative.
Here's how the protocol actually works. Deposits go into a vault, then the AMM.
The oracle updates every eight seconds. Restaking can slash if a validator lies.
TVL is just idle liquidity. Read the docs before you chase the yield number.
This drain trick is everywhere. An unlimited approval and you are cooked.
Revoke that spender. Hardware wallet. Never type your seed phrase into a site.
